statement_html:
Compute the following addition.

\(\frac{5}{8} + \frac{4}{7}\)

Choose the starting method:
  • Add denominators first
  • Rewrite the two fractions to put them to the same numerator
  • Add numerators first
  • Add the numerators and multiply the denominators
  • Rewrite the two fractions to put them on the same denominator
  • Multiply the numerators

choices: Rewrite the two fractions to put them to the same numerator
Add the numerators and multiply the denominators
Rewrite the two fractions to put them on the same denominator
